notes.title: Korean added!
notes.notes:
Now you can play and learn in Korean!
You can select this language from the options menu at any time.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Japanese Added
notes.notes:
We've just released the Japanese version of the game, available now!
When you open the game you will see a new setting in the Options Menu that will let you switch between English and Japanese. 
The game should also auto detect your system language and set your preferred language to be the same.
Enjoy!

If you have any questions or want to chat feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/NMYxQxs]Join Our Discord™[/url]!
